mechanism_narrative: The current low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as historically low rates compress discount rates and boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 215, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns due to inflation-driven policy tightening and risk-off sentiment.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 215.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 8% and employment level (PAYEMS) is below 130000, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns due to recessionary fears and weak labor market conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 8 and PAYEMS < 130000.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, when housing starts (HOUST) exceed 550, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns due to overheating and policy tightening fears.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 550 and the regime is late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns due to supply chain disruptions and recessionary concerns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP (GDPC1) is below 13000, the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns due to weak economic growth signaling recessionary pressures.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 < 13000.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 550 and residential sales (RSAFS) are below 350000, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns due to a housing market slowdown that signals economic weakness.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 550 and RSAFS < 350000.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime, when CPIAUCSL exceeds 215, the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns due to persistent inflation leading to aggressive monetary policy and equity market sell-off.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 215 and the regime is high inflation.
